core_obligations: Induct along the chain: the proof constructs the matching for the coarsest partition first and then refines it step by step along the chain of ordered partitions, using the author's partite construction at each step (proof lines 575-593).

Control the clique sizes: at each step the prescribed bounds m_P for the patterns of the partitions involved are respected, which is what the size identity of the statement records (proof lines 575-593).

The interpolation property: every two edges of the constructed matching form a pattern belonging to the union of the pattern families along the chain, which is the structural assertion of the statement (proof lines 575-593).
Conclusion: the matching has exactly the product size displayed in the statement, which is the lower-bound construction the paper needs (proof lines 575-593).
proof_roadmap: 沿有序划分链从粗到细逐步构造：每一步用作者的 r-partite 构造把划分细化一格，同时保持所有 m_P 界。
构造出的匹配满足：任意两条边构成的 pattern 落在链上各划分的 pattern 族之并中，且大小恰为所给乘积。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the sharp lower-bound construction of the paper (author theorem at source lines 455-459, label thm-paramteters-lower-bound-stronger): for any chain of ordered partitions of r and any prescribed positive integers m_P, there is an ordered r-uniform hypergraph matching of the displayed product size whose every pair of edges forms a pattern in the union of the pattern families and whose pattern-cliques stay below m_P. The proof (source lines 575-593) is the author's own, headed Proof of Theorem thm-paramteters-lower-bound-stronger, and it iterates the author's partite construction along the chain while keeping the clique-size bounds, which is what produces the exact product size. The theorem is the statement whose maximisation over chains gives the paper's lower-bound theorem, as the author notes immediately after it. H2.
